tagline: Modern, fun and elevated versions of American classics using only premium ingredients
hero_kpi_rationale: Digital sales represent the primary indicator of digital transformation and customer adoption, reflecting engagement via app, web, and third-party platforms, and now account for 37% of sales, making them a key lever for growth and customer experience.

kpis.name: Digital Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales generated through the Shake Shack app, website, and third-party delivery platforms.
kpis.description: Digital sales increased by 20.3% in fiscal year 2025, reaching $515.4 million, representing 37% of total sales.

kpis.name: System-wide Sales
kpis.explanation: Total sales from company-operated and licensed restaurants.
kpis.description: System-wide sales reached $2,228.8 million in 2025, up 15.9%, driven by new store openings and digital growth.

kpis.name: Same-Shack Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth from restaurants open for at least 24 months.
kpis.description: Same-Shack sales growth was 2.3% in 2025, driven by price increases (+3.1%), offsetting a decline in traffic (-0.8%).

kpis.name: Average Unit Volume
kpis.description: Average unit volume remained stable at $4.0 million in 2025, reflecting balanced price and traffic management.

kpis.name: Average Weekly Sales
kpis.explanation: Average weekly sales across all restaurants.
kpis.description: Average weekly sales remained stable at $76,000 in 2025, supported by pricing offsetting traffic decline.

kpis.name: New Shack Openings
kpis.explanation: Total number of new restaurants opened during the year.
kpis.description: In 2025, Shake Shack opened 85 new restaurants (45 company-operated, 40 licensed), marking significant geographic expansion.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.9 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.9 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Digital Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of sales generated through digital channels.
kpis.description: Digital sales mix reached 37.0% in 2025, up 2.1 points, indicating increasing customer adoption of digital channels.
kpis.signal: Progress toward 40%, evidence of customer adoption

risks.title: Growth
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on expansion to sustain growth, but this carries risks such as difficulty securing suitable locations and increased competition in new markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Security breaches can have severe consequences for the company, including loss of confidential data and reputational damage.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to numerous local and federal laws and regulations in each market it operates, including health, food safety, employment, and environmental regulations.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the fast-casual and fast-food industry is intense, and the company must continuously innovate to maintain market share and customer loyalty.

ai_positioning.summary: The company did not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report.
